description: Submit a compliance document for a payout. SWIFT payouts waiting for documents require it and the submission resumes the compliance review; the optional payment description is written to the SWIFT memo. Other rails (wire, ACH, RTP, Pix and so on) may attach an optional document while the payout is processing or completed. It is stored for compliance without changing the payout status or tracking, the description is ignored, and submitting again replaces the previous document.

Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key to safely retry this request without performing the action twice. Retrying with the same key and an identical body replays the original response; reusing a key with a different body returns an error. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

description.description: Optional payment description/memo for SWIFT payouts only (max 128 chars). Ignored for other rails.

transaction_document_id.description: Document identifier (invoice number, contract ID, etc.)
